tagline: Finish a concrete research errand with live cited evidence.
introduction: Use Exa-backed evidence to take one research-heavy errand for a named audience close to completion, leaving final approval to the user when needed. Show why fresh sources matter, handle contradictions and label unavailable live queries.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Exa? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design a search
capabilities.description: Define queries and filters from an information need.

capabilities.title: Evaluate retrieved evidence
capabilities.description: Review supplied evidence and rehearse literal excerpt coverage, URL deduplication and explicit date/retrieval gaps with fictional results; never infer truth from rank.

capabilities.title: Plan a cited comparison
capabilities.description: Create a comparison structure that preserves missing evidence.

capabilities.title: Design Exa challenge support
capabilities.description: Primary-source errand finisher. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Real task artifact with resolvable dated sources versus same model without search
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions

capabilities.title: Hand a dated rights question to the Internet Butler
capabilities.description: Prepare a bounded handoff for a question of the form 'what was I owed on that day': the person's situation in their own words, the event date and the country if stated. The package owner's Internet Butler finds the provision that applies, reads the official text as it stood on that date and as it stands today, and returns the amount with pinned official versions for the person to approve. It runs on the owner's machine: without a host connection, give the manual steps and label every amount unverified.
inputs: situation in the person's own words
outputs: handoff proposal; when connected, the provision, the amount then and now, and the pinned official versions
